name: EG Industries Berhad
overview: EG Industries 今年通过其全资子公司 SMT Industries 在泰国收购永久业权土地，扩大电子制造服务产能；同时增持泰国上市公司 N.D. Rubber 的股权至 41.59%，将业务延伸至能源与电动车相关领域。此外，公司进行了股本拆细并派发库存股作为中期股息。
overview_en: EG Industries expanded its electronic manufacturing services capacity through the acquisition of freehold land in Thailand by its wholly-owned subsidiary SMT Industries, and increased its stake in Thailand-listed N.D. Rubber to 41.59%, extending its business into energy and EV-related solutions. The company also undertook a share subdivision and distributed treasury shares as an interim dividend.

segments.name: 电子制造服务
segments.note: 今年通过泰国子公司收购土地，用于扩大制造产能。
segments.note_en: This year, the group acquired land through its Thai subsidiary to expand manufacturing capacity.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 SMT Industries Co., Ltd. 以约610万令吉收购泰国一块永久业权土地。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary SMT Industries Co., Ltd. acquired a piece of freehold land in Thailand for approximately RM6.1 million.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年增持泰国上市公司 N.D. Rubber 股权，并完成股本拆细及派发库存股股息。
segments.note_en: This year, the group increased its stake in Thailand-listed N.D. Rubber and completed a share subdivision and distribution of treasury shares as dividend.

actions.title: EG - Notice of Book Closure
actions.text_en: Announced an interim dividend of one treasury share for every 150 existing ordinary shares held.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 以每股泰铢1.50收购 N.D. Rubber 额外8000万股（17.51%股权），持股增至41.59%，以强化能源与电动车相关解决方案业务。
actions.text_en: Acquired an additional 80,000,000 shares (17.51% stake) in N.D. Rubber at THB1.50 per share, increasing shareholding to 41.59% to strengthen energy and EV-related solutions.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 通过增持 N.D. Rubber 股权至41.59%，将业务拓展至能源与电动车相关解决方案领域。
model_changes.text_en: By increasing its stake in N.D. Rubber to 41.59%, the group expanded its business into energy and EV-related solutions.
